title: vosu.chart
description: Best-effort, declared common namespace (ADR 0020): metadata for the chart (beatmap, in osu! terms) the session has selected or is playing. Capability id: field:vosu.chart(.<path>).

title.description: Chart/song title, in the game's display script (not necessarily Latin).

artist.description: Song artist, in the game's display script.

difficultyName.description: The selected difficulty's own name within its chart set, e.g. an osu! beatmap's `version`.

charter.description: Credited chart author, e.g. an osu! beatmap's mapper.

length.description: Chart length in milliseconds, unaffected by the current playback rate.

bpm.description: A representative BPM for the chart (its most common tempo), unaffected by the current playback rate. Full timing-point detail, where a game exposes it, lives in that game's own namespace.

keyCount.description: Lane/key count for charts with one, e.g. an osu!mania map's key count (including stable's key mods and dual-stage conversion); `null` for games or rulesets without a fixed lane count.

resources.description: Resource references for this chart's files (ADR 0021). A kind the current chart has no file for is omitted, never a reference to nothing.
